name: Oliversic
body: I am organizing a small archive of family song demos. The collection includes generated tracks with filenames that reveal very little. I want future listeners to know which file is the untouched source. A processed copy would have its own folder and a brief description of the change. How do you name these copies so that the history stays understandable? One phrase that appears in my background reading is [url=https://fixesuno.top]ai audio artifact removal[/url] in this context. That wording seems too broad to use as a guarantee about a particular recording. A description of the affected passage and the chosen settings seems clearer. The archive will include a short explanation of where each demo came from, who supplied it, and whether the copy was exported again or changed after the original file was received. Does anyone have a straightforward archive convention that remains clear over time?
